snapshot.title: User-only actions: ready, status, move, rm, deps
snapshot.description:
The user-only actions that currently need `buf curl`.

- `kiln ready <feature-id>`: promote a draft (UpdateItem, mask `feature.draft`).
- `kiln status <id> <status>`: set a task's status (including `done`) or a feature's override; `--clear` removes the override.
- `kiln move <id> --before <id> | --after <id>`: rerank.
- `kiln rm <id>`: delete.
- `kiln dep add <id> <blocker> [--until review]` and `kiln dep rm <id> <blocker>`.
- `kiln release <task-id>`: free a stuck claim.

Each command fetches the current revision itself.
